_notes: Ps 13 (Vulgate) = 思高 Ps 14; all 13:x verse references kept as-is (Vulgate numbering). Vs 13:3b–3d are the LXX/Vulgate addition (cf. Rom 3:13–17) not present in the Masoretic 思高 Ps 14; translated directly from Latin. Ps 122:1 (Vulgate=思高 123:1): 思高 opens with the heading '居住在诸天上的大主，我向你仰起我的眼目' — restructured to fit mediant. Ps 123:5 (Vulgate=思高 124:5): 思高 combines the 'torrent' and 'intolerable water' into one sentence; split at * for breviary mediant. Ps 124:2b has the ‡ flex marker preserved. Ps 126:4 (Vulgate=思高 127:4): 思高 v.4 is '年轻少壮所生的子嗣，有如勇士手中的箭矢'; second half ('ita filii excussorum') translated as '英雄的子嗣也是如此' since 思高 does not subdivide. Ps 129:4a (Vulgate=思高 130:4): 思高 renders as '可是，你以宽恕为怀，令人对你起敬起爱'; the Latin 'propter legem tuam sustinui te' added in second half. Ps 129:6 (Vulgate=思高 130:6–7): Latin 129:6 spans partial 思高 130:6 and 130:7; joined with mediant.
